scientific_integrity: Exact matrix algebra and analytically proven generator-wide bounds. Finite symbolic checks verify rational identities, not all CTMC generators. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Completed linear end-step only; nonlinear and internal-stage positivity not asserted.
For arbitrary Markov generators on ≤5 states the local positivity interval depends on Q.
For directed cycles longer than six only local failure and eventual positivity, not a full step-set formula.
Potential specialized unindexed prior results remain an originality risk.
title: Six states are the sharp small-step positivity barrier for two-stage Radau IIA on Markov generators
